name: 24-Hour Room Service Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
whyItWorks: Lean sliced roasted turkey breast on plain white or sourdough bread is ultra-low-fat, dairy-free, citrus-free, and easy to pack for port excursions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Roasted Turkey Sandwich on plain white bread (no seeds), dry or with mayo on the side, and remove any raw lettuce or tomato slices.
watchOuts: Remove raw lettuce and tomato slices
